rules: Background selection is deterministic from an isolated background seed.
Background values come from era/campaign-valid authored pools; no contemporary-Earth default is assumed.
Prior education may create evidence/context for later capability initialization but cannot directly assign expert proficiency.
Hobbies and interests do not force specialization.
Branch interests may correlate with background through future evidence rules, but Step 2 does not manufacture academic achievements.
No generated deep friendship, romance, roommate history or Academy group membership is created here.
Pre-Academy relationships may be preserved only when explicitly supplied by validated background state; Step 2 does not invent them.
